name: Seeking
overview: Scripture reveals that seeking God is a wholehearted pursuit that leads to finding Him and receiving His blessings. Passages such as Deuteronomy 4:29 and Psalms 9:10 emphasize that those who diligently seek the Lord with all their heart will not be forsaken and will lack no good thing. The Psalms express a deep longing and thirst for God's presence, illustrating that early and earnest seeking results in intimate fellowship with Him, as Proverbs 8:17 confirms. This pursuit includes seeking God's will, wisdom, and knowledge, contrasting with self-seeking or seeking revenge, which Scripture implicitly warns against by highlighting the blessings tied to seeking God himself.
